decks.notes: The key concept of this UW Control deck is to exert control over the game by countering and removing opponents' threats while drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck utilizes a combination of counterspells like Spell Pierce and Syncopate, card draw spells like Memory Deluge and Thirst for Discovery, and removal spells like Wash Away and Make Disappear. The deck also includes protection with cards like The Eternal Wanderer and offers some additional value with cards like Silver Scrutiny and Soul Partition. The mana base includes a mix of Islands and Plains along with some utility lands like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Deserted Beach.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The strategy revolves around playing aggressive threats like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Rona, Herald of Invasion, while also using removal spells like Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, as well as utility lands like Caves of Koilos to provide additional value. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining a strong board presence and applying pressure to the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to quickly establish a strong board presence. It also includes disruptive spells like Go for the Throat to control the opponent's creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and powerful enchantments, such as Plaza of Heroes and Shattered Sanctum. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Rona, Herald of Invasion provide additional late-game value and synergy with the rest of the deck.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control and removal cards to prevent opponents from building up their board presence and disrupting their strategy. The key strategy involves slowing down the opponent's game plan, maintaining board control, and gradually overwhelming them with powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also utilizes powerful support cards and utility lands to further strengthen its control over the game.

The main focus of this Esper Aggro deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. It utilizes a mix of efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Dennick, Pious Apprentice, along with disruption like Go for the Throat to control the game. Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Ao, the Dawn Sky provide additional aggression, while Raffine, Scheming Seer and Skrelv, Defector Mite offer card advantage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing fast and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary, and using burn spells like Play with Fire and Lightning Strike to remove blockers or finish off the opponent, this deck aims to close out the game quickly. Cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide additional damage and board control, while cards like Phoenix Chick and Mishra's Foundry help maintain card advantage and fuel the aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes powerful creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, supported by removal spells like Go for the Throat. The deck also includes cards that support its aggressive strategy, such as Raffine, Scheming Seer and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck, with lands like Shattered Sanctum and Plaza of Heroes providing additional benefits to the creatures.

This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Valiant Veteran and Recruitment Officer, while also utilizing spells like Make Disappear and Destroy Evil to control the opponent's board. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, while also utilizing cards like Protect the Negotiators and Fortified Beachhead to maintain tempo and protect its key threats. Additionally, cards like Skrelv, Defector Mite and Mirrex provide additional utility and evasion to close out games quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of control and aggressive creatures. By utilizing spells like Fateful Absence and Negate to disrupt your opponent's strategy, while also playing aggressive creatures like The Wandering Emperor and Memory Deluge to apply pressure, you can quickly take control of the game. Additionally, cards like Make Disappear and Reject Imperfection help to remove threats and clear the way for your creatures to attack. This deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting your opponent's plans to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy utilizing the synergy between Azorius cards. By playing a combination of creatures like Valiant Veteran and Skystrike Officer along with supportive spells like Make Disappear and Destroy Evil, the deck aims to maintain board control and apply pressure early on. The inclusion of cards like Resolute Reinforcements and Harbin, Vanguard Aviator provides additional ways to build a threatening battlefield presence. The deck's focus on aggression and synergy allows it to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures in order to deal damage as quickly as possible. It uses cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Recruitment Officer and Mishra's Foundry helps to consistently keep the board filled with threats. By playing aggressively and efficiently, this deck aims to pressure the opponent into making unfavorable trades and ultimately win the game through sheer speed and aggression.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities, such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, Dennick, Pious Apprentice, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Shattered Sanctum and Plaza of Heroes allows for additional value and protection for the creatures. Additionally, the deck includes powerful legendary creatures like Raffine, Scheming Seer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with support from Toluz, Clever Conductor and Ertai Resurrected to further advance the aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing powerful creatures and spells to dominate the battlefield. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play high-cost creatures like Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also using cards like Leyline Binding and Ossification to control enemy threats. With a mixture of creature removal, powerful creatures, and ramping capabilities, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through strategic plays and resource management in a 1 vs 1 Standard format.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim. The deck utilizes a mix of creature removal, card advantage, and disruption to outvalue and outlast opponents. With a solid mana base and a variety of threats and answers, this deck aims to slowly grind out victories by controlling the board and stifling opponents' game plans.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy a wide variety of aggressive creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with spells like Spell Pierce. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar keep the pressure on the opponent while Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Raffine, Scheming Seer provide card advantage. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gold-Forged Thopteryx allows for big swings in the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan while still being able to cast the necessary spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of reanimation effects and powerful creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Corpse Appraiser and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to put big threats like Etali, Primal Conqueror or Nahiri's Warcrafting into play, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence early on. Cards like The Cruelty of Gix and Go for the Throat help to deal with any opposing threats, while disruptive spells such as Duress and Cut Down can disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck's key strategy is to cheat powerful creatures into play and quickly close out the game.
